dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple high-contrast, thin horizontal white bands are visible across the greater and median coverts, created by pale feather margins.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible prominence is high; boundary sharpness is high, showing narrow, distinct white margins along the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Demarcation is defined by the abrupt transition from uniform light-gray plumage on the crown to the high-contrast scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined dark ocular mask contrasting against a pale gray face; overall heavy dorsal scalloping.
